_comment: Chromium managed policies — pin User-Agent, language, disable WebRTC IP leak, disable DoH (use system DNS via Azure DNS Private Resolver in egress region).
_note_useragent: User-Agent itself is forced via the entrypoint --user-agent flag (Chromium policies do not allow direct UA override).
_note_acceptlang: Accept-Language is forced via --accept-lang in the entrypoint plus IntlAcceptLanguage policy below.
